Metric Definitions

RMSE and mean L2 use the padded clean synthetic coordinates. Clean-cloud distances are nearest-neighbor approximations.

Normal energy ratio is the local covariance energy outside the intrinsic dimension; lower is better unless the method collapses.

Velocity-tangent alignment measures how much velocity lies in the locally estimated tangent space; higher is better.

Result-based interpretation

Flat rotation vector field: best RMSE was pca_rank_d (0.4793); best approximate clean-cloud distance was pca_rank_d (0.2492); best velocity-tangent alignment was pca_rank_d (1). This is expected because the true synthetic manifold is globally linear, making PCA-rank-d close to an oracle baseline. VMF movement cost is nontrivial at 0.533 local scales on average.

Flat spiral vector field: best RMSE was pca_rank_d (0.4711); best approximate clean-cloud distance was pca_rank_d (0.2407); best velocity-tangent alignment was pca_rank_d (1). PCA-rank-d has the lowest normal energy, but this should not be interpreted as true nonlinear manifold recovery, because PCA-rank-d can reduce normal energy by collapsing data into a global linear rank-d subspace. VMF movement cost is nontrivial at 0.536 local scales on average.

Flat saddle vector field: best RMSE was pca_rank_d (0.4706); best approximate clean-cloud distance was pca_rank_d (0.2376); best velocity-tangent alignment was pca_rank_d (1). This is expected because the true synthetic manifold is globally linear, making PCA-rank-d close to an oracle baseline. VMF movement cost is nontrivial at 0.525 local scales on average.

S-curve velocity flow: best RMSE was pca_rank_d (0.5613); best approximate clean-cloud distance was pca_rank_d (0.3374); best velocity-tangent alignment was pca_rank_d (1). In this setting, VMF does not clearly outperform PCA-rank-d on RMSE (0.5616 vs 0.5613) under the current parameter choices. PCA-rank-d has the lowest normal energy, but this should not be interpreted as true nonlinear manifold recovery, because PCA-rank-d can reduce normal energy by collapsing data into a global linear rank-d subspace. VMF movement cost is nontrivial at 0.536 local scales on average.

Swiss roll velocity flow: best RMSE was pca_rank_d (0.4868); best approximate clean-cloud distance was pca_rank_d (0.2999); best velocity-tangent alignment was pca_rank_d (1). In this setting, VMF does not clearly outperform PCA-rank-d on RMSE (0.5308 vs 0.4868) under the current parameter choices. PCA-rank-d has the lowest normal energy, but this should not be interpreted as true nonlinear manifold recovery, because PCA-rank-d can reduce normal energy by collapsing data into a global linear rank-d subspace. VMF movement cost is nontrivial at 0.54 local scales on average.

Half-sphere rotation field: best RMSE was velocity_manifold_fitter (0.5405); best approximate clean-cloud distance was pca_rank_d (0.3485); best velocity-tangent alignment was pca_rank_d (1). PCA-rank-d has the lowest normal energy, but this should not be interpreted as true nonlinear manifold recovery, because PCA-rank-d can reduce normal energy by collapsing data into a global linear rank-d subspace. VMF movement cost is nontrivial at 0.531 local scales on average.

Saddle-surface scalar potential: best RMSE was velocity_manifold_fitter (0.5228); best approximate clean-cloud distance was pca_rank_d (0.3377); best velocity-tangent alignment was pca_rank_d (1). PCA-rank-d has the lowest normal energy, but this should not be interpreted as true nonlinear manifold recovery, because PCA-rank-d can reduce normal energy by collapsing data into a global linear rank-d subspace. VMF movement cost is nontrivial at 0.509 local scales on average.

Cross-dataset summary: PCA-rank-d is strongest on globally linear flat simulations, while VMF should be judged mainly on nonlinear geometry and velocity-utility metrics. Low-dimensionality metrics alone are not sufficient evidence because global PCA can win them by construction.

Warning: if PCA-rank-d has the best normal energy on nonlinear datasets, that can reflect low-rank collapse into a global linear subspace rather than recovery of the curved manifold.

Unresolved issues: No method failures were recorded in this run.
